description: This is a FastAPI router module implementing CRUD operations for 'tags' in a web application. It defines API endpoints to list, create, update, and delete tags associated with a user.

methods.name: List[TagOut] list_tags( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves and returns a list of tags associated with the current user, ordered by name.

methods.name: TagOut create_tag( payload: TagCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new tag for the current user. Handles integrity errors if the tag already exists.

methods.name: TagOut update_tag( tag_id: uuid.UUID, payload: TagUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates the name of an existing tag belonging to the current user, identified by tag_id.

methods.name: None delete_tag( tag_id: uuid.UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Deletes a tag belonging to the current user, identified by tag_id.
